name: Living Greater Vital Spark · Lightning ×2
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.51-block radius for 21 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 5.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 5.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 15 s
• Growth: up to 15 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
